notes.title: Demo Update V1.7 (2025.09.06)
notes.notes:
Here’s what’s been updated in Demo V1.7:


🔸 Translations & UI:
 Fixed various translation issues

 Corrected “Press any button” prompt when using a controller (previously showed “Press any key”)

🔸 Visual & Audio:
 Multiple lighting changes to improve atmosphere and tension in different areas

 Adjusted triggers for doors, lights, and events to create smoother pacing

 Updated certain sound effects for better immersion

 Adjusted colliders and interactions for smoother gameplay



Found a bug or issue? Share it with us on the Steam forums or our official Discord so we can get it fixed.

Thank you for playing the demo and helping us improve. Your feedback means a lot!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Mark your calendars! Unmourned arrives on Steam on Monday, November 17, 2025!


We can’t wait for you to experience the terror!

🔔 Wishlist now to get notified the moment the game is available.

🎥 Check out the trailer and share the news with your friends.



Thank you for supporting us on this journey — your wishlists, feedback, and encouragement mean everything. The nightmare begins soon.

notes.title: Demo Update V1.2 (2025.04.15)
notes.notes:
We’ve released Unmourned Demo Update V1.2 (2025.04.15), bringing even more fixes and improvements:

🔸 Translations:

 Corrected German translation for the Sanity System (title, description, and tips)

🔸 Input:

 The game now starts with keyboard/mouse as the default input method

🔸 Visual & Gameplay Improvements:

 Adjusted sounds for better environmental feedback
 Made the [spoiler]mirror event[/spoiler] trigger more reliably
 Fixed incorrect language dropdown value in the main menu after selecting a language for the first time
 Adjusted intro animation for better flow
 Fixed slight camera offset issue in the intro
 Added various environmental enhancements to increase immersion and tension in the house
 Minor fixes in the settings menu

If you run into any issues, don’t hesitate to share them on our Steam forums or official Discord, and we'll fix them as soon as we can.

Thank you for playing the demo and helping us improve. Your feedback means a lot!
